subject: Offer for Sofia Ramos — terms, comp band, and start date questions
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Offer letter draft for Sofia Ramos — need start date and comp band confirmation

Hi Marissa,

Good news — Sofia gave a verbal acceptance on the compensation outlined in the SDR/IC band. She asked for the offer letter to be sent this week so she can confirm a start date with her current manager.

Attached is the standard offer template I pulled (Sofia_Ramos_Offer_Template_v2.docx) and a one-page comp band quick reference. Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the base and RSU schedule we discussed (base $150k, target OTE $190k, 4,000 RSUs at 4-year schedule) and whether we want a 1-year cliff or 6-month initial vest?
- Any constraints on start date? Candidate prefers Mar 22 or Apr 5.
- Do you want me to include the relocation stipend language (candidate is remote but open to relocation)?

If this looks good I can route to People Ops for finalization, but Vivek / Markus need to sign off on the comp and any legal redlines.

Thanks — I attached the template and comp band.

Best,
Lauren
--
Lauren Bishop
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: Sofia_Ramos_Offer_Template_v2.docx (Word doc, 48 KB)
Attachment: comp_band_quickref.pdf (PDF, 122 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Offer letter draft for Sofia Ramos — need start date and comp band confirmation

Thanks Lauren — and congrats on closing the verbal. I reviewed the template and have a few redlines inline below. I pasted short notes rather than editing the doc to keep the thread tidy.

Redlines / open items:
- Base and OTE: confirm $150,000 base, target $190,000 OTE. OK with me.
- RSUs: prefer 3,200 RSUs at 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff (standard for ICs in our band). The 4,000 figure pushes this role above our comp band midline; Markus, can you confirm legal / payroll impact?
- Cliff: request 1-year cliff (no pro-rata half-cliff). Candidate knows there will be a cliff — mention it explicitly.
- Start date: Mar 22 is tight for notice and relocation paperwork. Favor Apr 5 to ensure background and equipment provisioning.
- Relocation: candidate is remote; we should not include relocation unless she requests explicitly. Keep relocation language out for now.
- Equity grant language: remove "performance-based" qualifier — use standard grant agreement wording.

Headcount note: We have a conditional headcount approval in the FY26 recruiting plan but final finance signoff is still pending. Vivek — can you confirm headcount/comp commit? If finance needs a PO or cost center move I can pause.

If you want, I can make these edits directly in the doc and send to Monica for People Ops finalization.

Marissa

Marissa / Lauren —

Thanks for the thread and the quick turnaround. Finance approved the headcount for Q2 hiring in the SRE stream last week; we have the budget for the $150k base plus OTE stated. I am comfortable approving 3,200 RSUs at a standard 4-year schedule with a 1-year cliff.

Request from my side: change cliff language to call out "one-year cliff followed by monthly vesting" rather than ambiguous phrasing. That removes confusion for payroll / equity ops.

Also, mark the hire as remote (California) for tax paperwork. Monica — please prepare the final offer packet, confirm background check vendor timeline, and flag any payroll setup items if candidate chooses Apr 5 as start date.

Markus — I didn't see any legal showstoppers in the template, but please advise if you recommend alternate wording for the grant agreement.

Vivek
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-02-17T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Finalized offer packet for Sofia Ramos — please review before send

Hi team,

Thanks — I updated the template per the notes. Key changes:
- Equity: set to 3,200 RSUs, 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff, monthly thereafter.
- Cliff language standardized as: "Subject to the terms of the Equity Award Agreement, 25% of the Restricted Stock Units will vest on the first anniversary of the Vesting Start Date; thereafter the remaining Restricted Stock Units will vest in equal monthly installments over the remaining 36 months."
- Removed relocation language.
- Payroll/tax: flagged as "Remote - CA" so payroll team will create W-2 and CA tax withholding.
- Background check vendor: VerifiedFirst; expected turnaround 3 business days from submission.

I've attached the draft PDF (Sofia_Ramos_Offer_v1.pdf) for review. Please reply with any last edits by EOD tomorrow. If no replies, I'll route to Lauren to send to the candidate with the DocuSign link.

One open item: candidate's preferred start date. I recommend we propose Apr 5 to give us time for onboarding logistics.

Monica Patel
People Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: Sofia_Ramos_Offer_v1.pdf (PDF, 94 KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@gmail.com>
Cc: Randall ExecSearch <randall@execsearch.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Offer from Redwood Inference — Sofia Ramos (Please review)

Hi Sofia —

Congratulations again — please find attached the formal offer from Redwood Inference. Highlights below:
- Base salary: $150,000 annually
- Target OTE: $190,000
- Equity: 3,200 RSUs (4-year schedule with 1-year cliff, monthly thereafter)
- Start date: proposed Apr 5, 2026 (let us know if you need an earlier date)

Next steps: please review the attached PDF and sign via the DocuSign link I will send after you confirm acceptance. Background check (VerifiedFirst) will be initiated after you sign. If you have any questions about the wording on equity cliff or start date, reply to this thread.

We listed you as "Remote - CA" for payroll setup; if you plan to relocate out of state within 30 days please let us know.

Welcome to the team — excited to get you onboarded.

Best,
Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
